say:0:1027301001:0.text: I hear someone up ahead, but it doesn't sound like Yolanda.
say:0:1027301001:0.source_cn: 唔，前面有人的声音，但不像是约兰达。

say:1:1027301002:0.text: Why does this voice sound oddly familiar?
say:1:1027301002:0.source_cn: 不过……奇怪，这声音怎么有点耳熟？

say:3:1027302001:0.text: Well, well, look who we've got here.
say:3:1027302001:0.source_cn: 啧，真是不巧啊，居然在这儿重逢了。

say:4:1027302002:0.text: You're that treasure hunter! No wonder I recognized your voice!
say:4:1027302002:0.source_cn: 你是那个——宝藏猎人！怪不得声音那么耳熟！

say:5:1027302003:1.text: I remember you saying you traveled to the Dark Forest to find hidden riches... have you set your sights on the <style="highlight">Deer Spirit's treasure</style> now?
say:5:1027302003:1.source_cn: 我记得你说过，来薄暮丛林是为了寻找隐秘的宝藏……这么看...

say:6:1027302004:1.text: How very astute. Looks like you've got a knack for this business as well.
say:6:1027302004:1.source_cn: 嗯哼，没错，没想到你们居然来得这么快。看起来你们也挺有...

say:7:1027302005:1.text: Well, there's no beating around the bush. I am indeed here for the treasure.
say:7:1027302005:1.source_cn: 好吧，既然被你们发现了，那我也不绕弯子了。没错，我就是...

say:8:1027302006:1.text: Unfortunately, it wasn't until after I arrived that I realized there was a problem with the puzzle here.
say:8:1027302006:1.source_cn: ——很可惜，到了这边我才发现，这里的机关出了问题。

choice_prompt:9:1027302006.text: Unfortunately, it wasn't until after I arrived that I realized there was a problem with the puzzle here.
choice_prompt:9:1027302006.source_cn: ——很可惜，到了这边我才发现，这里的机关出了问题。

say:10:1027302007:1.text: Not sure, but some part of it is broken. I fiddled with it for half a day with no luck.
say:10:1027302007:1.source_cn: 天晓得，反正我摆弄了半天都没反应。

say:11:1027302010:1.text: Of course, it's not because I couldn't solve it myself...
say:11:1027302010:1.source_cn: 不过，真是奇怪啊。照理说，这种以神之名存留的古代机关通...

say:12:1027302011:1.text: Perhaps it's gotten rusty with age?
say:12:1027302011:1.source_cn: 难不成年久失修，生锈了？

say:13:1027302012:1.text: What nonsense is that?! How could something left by the Deer Spirit get rusty?!
say:13:1027302012:1.source_cn: 你在胡说什么？！鹿灵留下的东西怎么可能生锈？！

say:14:1027302013:1.text: Ah, true. It's all made of wood, anyway... my best guess is that certain parts grew moss and rotted away.
say:14:1027302013:1.source_cn: 啊——很有道理，这里的机关都是木制，要说的话也是长了苔...

say:15:1027302014:1.text: Scoundrel! I can't believe you'd disrespect the Deer Spirit!
say:15:1027302014:1.source_cn: 你——你这家伙！居然对鹿灵不敬！

say:16:1027302015:1.text: No, no, I just trust the laws of nature more than the gods.
say:16:1027302015:1.source_cn: 不不不，只是比起神明，我更相信大自然的规律。

say:17:1027302016:1.text: If you don't believe me, go see for yourself. Seeing is believing, after all.
say:17:1027302016:1.source_cn: 如果不相信我说的，为什么不亲自去看看呢？眼见为实嘛。

say:19:1027302008:1.text: Well, there's a malfunction in this puzzle so it can't be solved.
say:19:1027302008:1.source_cn: 你也说了，那得是谜题。谜题才能解开，故障只能被维修。
say:19:1027302008:1.male: Well, there's a malfunction in this puzzle so it can't be solved.
say:19:1027302008:1.female: Well, there's a malfunction in this puzzle so it can't be solved.

say:20:1027302009:1.text: As it stands, I'm not the best at repairing things. I fiddled with it for half a day with no luck.
say:20:1027302009:1.source_cn: 不巧，我对修理这行暂时没多少涉猎，所以正在研究呢。

say:0:1027303001:0.text: Pursuing the treasure of the Deer Spirit while simultaneously mocking it... unbelievable!
say:0:1027303001:0.source_cn: 觊觎鹿灵的宝藏，居然还对鹿灵大放厥词……真是可恶！

say:1:1027303002:0.text: We gotta get the treasure before she does! She deserves a generous slice of humble pie.
say:1:1027303002:0.source_cn: 我们必须得先她一步拿到宝藏！让她鸡飞蛋打！

say:0:1027304001:0.text: Woah, why are there monsters here? Could it mean you unlocked the mechanism?
say:0:1027304001:0.source_cn: 喂，这里怎么会出现怪物？难道说……你们解开了机关？

say:1:1027304002:0.text: Didn't expect that, huh? All thanks to the wisdom of <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:1:1027304002:0.male: Didn't expect that, huh? All thanks to the wisdom of <style="stress"><player_name></style>!
say:1:1027304002:0.female: Didn't expect that, huh? All thanks to the wisdom of <style="stress"><player_name></style>!

say:3:1027305001:1.text: Monsters have actually appeared... turns out the mechanism wasn't broken; it's just that the puzzle was set up in a bizarre way.
say:3:1027305001:1.source_cn: 居然出现了怪物……原来机关确实没有坏掉，只是谜题的设置...

say:4:1027305002:1.text: So, tell me, how'd you figure it out?
say:4:1027305002:1.source_cn: 喂，我说，你们几个，怎么打开机关的？

say:5:1027305003:0.text: The level of our devotion to the Deer Spirit is something a mere treasure hunter could never understand.
say:5:1027305003:0.source_cn: 大概是凭着一颗对鹿灵虔敬的心，和普通的寻宝猎人无法比拟...

say:6:1027305004:1.source_cn: 好了，洛桑，对客人要保持礼仪。

say:7:1027305005:1.text: Miss Atalanta, the Deer Spirit's treasure is a gift from Misarte, and it will be found by one who is wise and deserving enough.
say:7:1027305005:1.source_cn: 阿塔兰忒小姐，你不用如此警惕。鹿灵宝藏是弥萨忒留给聪慧...

say:8:1027305006:1.text: And with all my poking fun at Misarte, you think the Deer Spirit wouldn't let someone like me find it?
say:8:1027305006:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，那就算是我这个对弥萨忒大放厥词的家伙拿到宝藏，...

choice_prompt:9:1027305006.text: And with all my poking fun at Misarte, you think the Deer Spirit wouldn't let someone like me find it?
choice_prompt:9:1027305006.source_cn: 哎呀呀，那就算是我这个对弥萨忒大放厥词的家伙拿到宝藏，鹿灵也不会有意见喽？

say:10:1027305007:1.text: With those big ears, he's impossible to ignore.
say:10:1027305007:1.source_cn: 那个兔子耳朵的声音那么大，听不到才难。

say:11:1027305009:1.text: No matter who solves each puzzle, we shall rejoice that someone was wise enough to pass the Deer Spirit's test.
say:11:1027305009:1.source_cn: 是的，阿塔兰忒小姐，无论是谁解开谜题，我们都只会感到喜...

say:12:1027305010:1.text: What's more, this time, it was due to <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but I feel he was indeed guided by Misarte.
say:12:1027305010:1.source_cn: 更何况，这次解开谜题，本就是出于<style=stre...
say:12:1027305010:1.male: What's more, this time, it was due to <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but I feel he was indeed guided by Misarte.
say:12:1027305010:1.female: What's more, this time, it was due to <style="stress"><player_name></style>, but I feel she was indeed guided by Misarte.

say:13:1027305011:1.text: *Sigh* You devout types. Let's talk about what happens next, shall we?
say:13:1027305011:1.source_cn: 唉，你们这些虔诚的家伙……已经解开的谜题就这样吧，商量...

say:14:1027305012:1.text: I've got cunning and wits in my quiver, and you've got your so-called wisdom and faith.
say:14:1027305012:1.source_cn: 你看，我跑得快，消息灵通，而你们呢，有所谓的智慧和信仰——

choice_prompt:15:1027305012.text: I've got cunning and wits in my quiver, and you've got your so-called wisdom and faith.
choice_prompt:15:1027305012.source_cn: 你看，我跑得快，消息灵通，而你们呢，有所谓的智慧和信仰——

say:16:1027305013:1.text: Let's not get hung up on particulars here.
say:16:1027305013:1.source_cn: 别计较这种无关紧要的形容词，这都是些小事。

say:17:1027305014:1.text: And let's team up! We can go at this together.
say:17:1027305014:1.source_cn: 所以，要不要合作？我们一起。
say:17:1027305014:1.male: And let's team up! We can go at this together.
say:17:1027305014:1.female: And let's team up! We can go at this together.

say:18:1027305016:1.text: The Deer Spirit should have left quite a bit of treasure behind, right? I'll scout the locations, and if there are any more puzzles like this one that I can't solve, you'll step in.
say:18:1027305016:1.source_cn: 鹿灵应该留下不少宝藏吧？我找到地点，要是还有像这次这样...
say:18:1027305016:1.male: The Deer Spirit should have left quite a bit of treasure behind, right? I'll scout the locations, and if there are any more puzzles like this one that I can't solve, you'll step in.
say:18:1027305016:1.female: The Deer Spirit should have left quite a bit of treasure behind, right? I'll scout the locations, and if there are any more puzzles like this one that I can't solve, you'll step in.

say:19:1027305017:1.text:
Everyone pulls their weight.
And if you do find the ultimate treasure, well, good for you.
say:19:1027305017:1.source_cn: 大家根据出力平均分配。\n要是真的找到了最终宝藏，哇，...
say:19:1027305017:1.male:
Everyone pulls their weight.
And if you do find the ultimate treasure, well, good for you.
say:19:1027305017:1.female:
Everyone pulls their weight.
And if you do find the ultimate treasure, well, good for you.

say:20:1027305018:1.text: Because in the end, I'm only after one specific thing—the rest is all yours.
say:20:1027305018:1.source_cn: 因为最终宝藏我只要挑其中一件，其他的就全——部都归你们...
say:20:1027305018:1.male: Because in the end, I'm only after one specific thing—the rest is all yours.
say:20:1027305018:1.female: Because in the end, I'm only after one specific thing—the rest is all yours.

say:21:1027305019:1.text:
So, what do you think, huh? Interested?
Mutual benefit trumps a rivalry, no?
say:21:1027305019:1.source_cn: 怎么样，心动了吧？要不要考虑一下？\n互利共赢，可比竞...
say:21:1027305019:1.male:
So, what do you think, huh? Interested?
Mutual benefit trumps a rivalry, no?
say:21:1027305019:1.female:
So, what do you think, huh? Interested?
Mutual benefit trumps a rivalry, no?

choice_prompt:22:1027305019.text:
So, what do you think, huh? Interested?
Mutual benefit trumps a rivalry, no?
choice_prompt:22:1027305019.source_cn: 怎么样，心动了吧？要不要考虑一下？\n互利共赢，可比竞争关系要可靠多了吧？
choice_prompt:22:1027305019.male:
So, what do you think, huh? Interested?
Mutual benefit trumps a rivalry, no?
choice_prompt:22:1027305019.female:
So, what do you think, huh? Interested?
Mutual benefit trumps a rivalry, no?

say:23:1027305020:1.text: In a world full of treasures, one must know when to adapt and work with people.
say:23:1027305020:1.source_cn: 世界上的宝物千千万，想要打听消息，没有点聊天技巧怎么行？
say:23:1027305020:1.male: In a world full of treasures, one must know when to adapt and work with people.
say:23:1027305020:1.female: In a world full of treasures, one must know when to adapt and work with people.

say:24:1027305022:0.text: Are you so sure you'll be the first to the treasure? What if someone else beats you there?
say:24:1027305022:0.source_cn: 你就这么肯定能第一个找到宝藏？要是被抢先了呢？

say:25:1027305023:1.text: Someone else? Do you know someone else who's out looking for the treasure?
say:25:1027305023:1.source_cn: 抢先？是你们吗？还是说……有别人也在一起寻找宝藏？

say:26:1027305024:1.text: Erm... well... I was just saying...

say:27:1027305025:1.text: Well, Rabbit Ears, you're as bad of a liar as you are a fighter.
say:27:1027305025:1.source_cn: 好了好了，兔耳朵小哥，你说谎的水平和你战斗的水平一样难...

say:28:1027305026:1.text: Since there are clearly other people also searching for this treasure, I should get moving.
say:28:1027305026:1.source_cn: 好——既然还有其他寻宝者，那我可得尽快动身了。

say:31:1027305028:1.source_cn: 很好，我喜欢干脆利落的人！

say:34:1027305029:1.text: You didn't have to! I saw it in your eyes. *Giggle*
say:34:1027305029:1.source_cn: 但你也没有拒绝吧？就当你默认了。
say:34:1027305029:1.male: You didn't have to! I saw it in your eyes. *Giggle*
say:34:1027305029:1.female: You didn't have to! I saw it in your eyes. *Giggle*

say:35:1027305021:1.text: Well, thanks, but I don't part with the treasure I collect so easily, even for gold.
say:35:1027305021:1.source_cn: 多谢夸奖，不过我可不会轻易把找到的宝贝换成金子。
say:35:1027305021:1.male: Well, thanks, but I don't part with the treasure I collect so easily, even for gold.
say:35:1027305021:1.female: Well, thanks, but I don't part with the treasure I collect so easily, even for gold.

choice:22:1:2.text: You'd do well as a saleswoman.
choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 感觉你也会是个好商人
choice:22:1:2.male: You'd do well as a saleswoman.
choice:22:1:2.female: You'd do well as a saleswoman.

say:36:1027305015:1.text:
Nothing gets by you. 
That's right, you and me. A little cooperative effort.
say:36:1027305015:1.source_cn: 反应很快嘛。\n没错，你和我。合作。
say:36:1027305015:1.male:
Nothing gets by you. 
That's right, you and me. A little cooperative effort.
say:36:1027305015:1.female:
Nothing gets by you. 
That's right, you and me. A little cooperative effort.
